services_subhead: From emergency repairs to full rewires, we handle every type of domestic and commercial electrical work with precision and speed.

services.title: Emergency Callouts
services.desc: Faulty wiring, blown fuses, or tripped circuits disrupting your home or business? We're on-call 24/7 and aim to arrive within 30 minutes across Birmingham.

services.title: Full House Rewires
services.desc: Old wiring putting your home at risk? We replace outdated cable, upgrade your consumer unit, and bring everything up to current Building Regulations. Most properties completed in 3–5 days.

services.title: Socket & Switch Installation
services.desc: Add new sockets, USB charging points, or smart switches exactly where you need them. We make the routing neat and test every circuit before we leave.

services.title: Boiler & Heating Electrics
services.desc: Faulty immersion heater or heating system electrics causing problems? We diagnose and repair heating-related faults, including underfloor heating wiring.

services.title: Fault Finding & Testing
services.desc: Intermittent electrical faults are our speciality. We use professional test equipment to pinpoint the problem and fix it once and for all, with a written report.

services.title: Commercial & Industrial Work
services.desc: Small business or large industrial site? We handle commercial installations, maintenance contracts, and fire safety testing to keep your premises running smoothly.

about_pullquote: I got into this trade because cowboys were ripping off my own family. Not on my watch.
about_para_1: AM Pro Electrical was founded 18 years ago when our owner decided there had to be a better way. Tired of seeing homeowners charged eye-watering call-out fees and unnecessary work, he started the business on one simple promise: honest diagnosis, fair pricing, and first-time fixes. Over nearly two decades, we've completed over 2,400 jobs across Birmingham and the surrounding areas, from burst pipes and boiler installs to full electrical rewires.
about_para_2: Today, we're known in Birmingham for turning up on time, doing the job properly, and leaving customers with confidence in their electrics. Our repeat customer rate is above 70%, and we've built relationships with local property managers, landlords, and small business owners who know they can rely on us. Every electrician in the team is fully trained and insured, and we're accountable for every job we touch.
reviews_heading: What Birmingham Homes & Businesses Say About Us

reviews.text: Had a dodgy socket that kept tripping. Called AM Pro on a Sunday afternoon and they were here within the hour. Turned out it was a dodgy wire that needed replacing. Fair quote, quick job, and they even tidied up after themselves. Top blokes.
reviews.author: Mark T.

reviews.text: Full house rewire quote from another firm was nearly £8k. AM Pro came in at £5,200 and the work quality was immaculate. No rush, explained everything, and I'd trust them with any electrical work in future.
reviews.author: Sandra L.

reviews.text: We've used them for our small office for 3 years now. They service our circuits, install new equipment, and always turn up when they say they will. Never had a problem, never been overcharged. Definitely recommend them.
reviews.author: David K.
